objective: Search, as two deliberately separate user interfaces: a free-text bar over GET /search/accounts and GET /search/posts rendering accounts first then posts, each independently paginated; and a sports-data filter control with no free-text input at all, driven by dropdowns over GET /search/games/filters, GET /events/teams and GET /search/games.
acceptance_criteria: The free-text bar calls GET /search/accounts and GET /search/posts independently, and renders the account results above the post results.
Accounts and posts each have their own load-more control driven by their own next_offset, and loading more of one does not refetch the other.
Post results render through the feed unit's PostNode components rather than a search-specific post renderer.
The sports-data UI renders no text input of any kind; a test asserts the absence of every textbox and searchbox role within it.
The season options come from GET /search/games/filters, the team options from GET /events/teams, and the position options from the filters response's positions field.
Applying the filters calls GET /search/games with the selected season, team and position, and changing a filter re-queries rather than filtering the previous results client-side.
An empty result set from either UI renders an explicit no-results state naming what was searched.
The free-text bar renders on both the home page and the search route, and both entry points reach the same results view.
